summary: Layer 1B expands the US-listed universe around the AI data-center power chokepoint while deliberately avoiding hyperscaler and mega-cap crowding. The strongest underfollowed lane candidates found in this pass are specialty electrical contractors, substation/transmission builders, medium-voltage power-equipment suppliers, and nuclear-fuel-cycle assets. This is a research universe expansion only, not a buy/sell recommendation.
